descriptions.zh: [Target.GetName]上的一个主要殖民定居点外，“雪”开始聚集起来。这样的一个沙漠行星，下雪肯定是不寻常的。
descriptions.en: Snow has begun congregating outside of one of the main colonial settlements on [Target.GetName], a desert planet where snow is a decidedly unusual occurrence.

descriptions.zh: 我们已经在[Target.GetName]上发现了一个可疑的、看上去是外星人修建的迷宫。目前对于它是怎么到那儿、为什么到那儿还没有定论。
descriptions.en: We have discovered a suspicious, seemingly alien labyrinth on [Target.GetName]. It is unclear how or why it got there.

descriptions.zh: 在击败了§Y[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]§!之后，我们认为在§Y[Target.GetName]§!上举办一场以我们收获的[Root.GetTrophyName]为主题的[Owner.GetParadeStudy]对我们的帝国多有裨益。
descriptions.en: After defeating the §Y[This.GetLeviathanTargetName]§!, we believe that a [Owner.GetParadeStudy] on §Y[Target.GetName]§! focusing on the [Root.GetTrophyName] we secured would be very beneficial to our empire.

sections.zh: 在[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]污染被清理干净之前，我们的[Owner.GetParadeStudy]暂停举办。
sections.en: This [Owner.GetParadeStudy] is on hold until the [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] contamination can cleaned up.

descriptions.zh: §Y[From.Target.GetName]§!离开了自身的稳定轨道，呈螺旋轨迹进入恒星系的黑洞。尽管这一事件给予我们一个绝无仅有的攫取大量£sr_dark_matter£§H暗物质§!和£physics£§H物理学研究§!的契机，如果我们不迅速行动抵消黑洞的拖拽引力，这座空间站很快就会被黑洞吞没。
descriptions.en: The §Y[From.Target.GetName]§! has left its stable orbit and is now spiraling into the system's black hole. While the incident offers us a never-before-seen opportunity to harvest £sr_dark_matter£§HDark Matter§! and £physics£ §HPhysics Research§!, if we don't act fast to counteract the gravitational pull of the black hole, the station will soon be swallowed whole.

descriptions.zh:
一场恒星活动的激增正在削弱§Y[Target.GetName]§!的磁层，将我们的机械暴露在危险量级的电离辐射中。投资辐射抵抗技术可以保护我们的子个体在风暴结束之前免受损伤。
§H该局势会在§Y[Target.storm_duration]§!月之内结束。§!
descriptions.en:
An increase in solar activity is weakening §Y[Target.GetName]§!'s magnetosphere, exposing our machines to dangerous levels of ionizing radiation. Invest in radiation hardening techniques to shield our drones against damage until the storm subsides.
§HThe situation will end in §Y[Target.storm_duration]§! month(s).§!

descriptions.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]给养被虚空孳孽的酸性毒液污染了。
descriptions.en: Our [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] supply has been contaminated with the acidic venom from the Voidspawn.

descriptions.zh: 我们的恒星[Target.GetName]最近的行为极度怪异，它的能量产出远远低于平常。如果不能尽快找到应对措施，我们将会面临生态灾难！
descriptions.en: Our star, [Target.GetName], has been acting extremely oddly recently, generating a lot less energy than usual. If this is not remedied soon we could be facing ecological disaster!

descriptions.zh:
一种五彩斑斓的能源寄生虫正在侵染我们的能源电网，提高了我们的能源供给。我们可以放任它，或者通过§Y谍报行动§!将这个麻烦传导到其他帝国。

[GetKaleidoscopeMood]。
descriptions.en:
A colorful energy parasite is infecting our power grid, feasting on our energy supplies. We could indulge it, or use an §YEspionage Operation§! to pass this problem to another empire.

[GetKaleidoscopeMood].

sections.zh: 让§H万华镜§!寄生虫挨饿会降低它的§Y心情§!，提高负面事件的发生几率。给它投喂会提高它的心情，维持它愉悦和稳定。
sections.en: Starving the §HKaleidoscope§! will lower its §Ymood§!, increasing the chance of negative events. Feeding it will increase it, keeping it appeased and placid.

sections.zh: 让§H万华镜§!寄生虫挨饿会降低它的§Y心情§!，提高负面事件的发生几率。给它投喂会提高它的心情，维持它愉悦和稳定。
sections.en: Starving the §HKaleidoscope§! will lower its §Ymood§!, increasing the chance of negative events. Feeding it will increase it, keeping it appeased and placid.

descriptions.zh: 我们遭遇了一个位于“贝塔宇宙”内的糟糕境况，对于这个正在崩坏的次元，我们必须立刻决定是袖手旁观还是鼎力相助。
descriptions.en: We have been confronted with a terrible situation inside the 'Beta-Universe' and must now decide if we are to stand aside or assist the doomed dimension.

sections.zh: 将[Target.GetName]-贝塔带到我们的宇宙

sections.en: Observe the decay of the Beta-Universe
